context:
Goal: a revert of a red main merges without stopping on a prompt, with no check lifted that you did not allow.
Problem (rule): PR 3097 adds the rule `Bash(merge * --confirm --head * --base-red-ok *)` to settings.json. Two things stop it. (1) Decision auto-mode-owner-acts (lines 66 and 76) says the merge allow entries never cover a flag that lifts a check, naming --base-red-ok. Decision no-merge-onto-red-main (line 21) lets Claude type that flag with a logged reason, so only the prompt is at stake. (2) A repo test (merge/test_merge.py, test_the_repo_settings_json_has_no_merge_allow_rule) refuses any merge allow rule in settings.json, and PR 3097's run 43375520417 failed on exactly that, not on main's red. A lane may not weaken a test.
Based on (read): the lane's report; I read the decision lines and the test myself.
Departs from: main — a drops the rule; b adds it to merge/cloud_allow.json, which changes the decision text that says entries never cover this flag; c also changes the test to allow one rule in settings.json.
Meanwhile: the lane waits; no push, draft flip or hand-in. Closing PR 3097 is your act and is not offered here.
home: PR #3097; step allow-merge-base-red-ok; decisions auto-mode-owner-acts (lines 66 and 76) and no-merge-onto-red-main (line 21); test test_the_repo_settings_json_has_no_merge_allow_rule
lastAnswer: 786 c: rule in settings.json too, test re-pointed.

reply: Answered 786 c (19:21 CST Nov 13), filed as ruling own-786-c-base-red-ok-settings. The same PR rewrites the two decision sentences that say entries never cover --base-red-ok, and gets a guard review. Kept open with your answer on the page until the lane fetches it; nothing for you to do.
short: PR 3097: allow rule for --base-red-ok, and where?
